preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 300), and the second line contains exactly n space-separated lowercase Latin-letter words.

preconditions.expression: all(word.islower() and word.isalpha() for word in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All words in the input consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.isdigit() and (int(stdout) == len(stdin.split()[1:]) + (n - 1)) or (any(len(stdin.split()[1:]) + (n - 1) - (len(abbr) - (j - i + 1)) > 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n) for abbr in [stdin.split()[1:][i:j+1]] for k in range(n) for l in range(k, n) if (l - k + 1 == j - i + 1) and (stdin.split()[1:][k:l+1] == stdin.split()[1:][i:j+1]) and (int(stdout) == len(stdin.split()[1:]) + (n - 1) - (len(''.join(w[0] for w in stdin.split()[1:][i:j+1]).upper()) - (j - i + 1)))))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible length of the text after performing at most one abbreviation. If no abbreviation is performed, the length is the sum of the lengths of all words plus (n - 1) spaces. If an abbreviation is performed, the length is the original length minus the number of characters replaced by the abbreviation (i.e., the sum of the lengths of the words in the segment minus the length of the uppercase abbreviation).
